about: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres is a Singapore data center operator with facilities in Singapore, India, Indonesia, the UK, Ireland, the US and elsewhere, serving cloud, content and enterprise customers. It is majority-owned by ST Telemedia, which is part of Temasek, with KKR and Singtel acquiring a stake in 2025. Revenue comes from colocation and hyperscale leases. B2B infrastructure with no consumer awareness.

team.blue is a Ghent, Belgium-based European online enabler offering web hosting, domain names, e-commerce, email and online presence services to small businesses and entrepreneurs, formed by a combination of hosting providers including Combell, Register.it, one.com, Hostnet, Ascio and Zoner. Backed by Hellman & Friedman and Partners Group. Customers are around 3 million small businesses in 20 countries. Reported funding about $1.8 billion. Low consumer awareness; regional hosting brands.
cb_desc: team.blue is a online enabler that helps local entrepreneurs...

about: Stockholm-based Swedish telecoms equipment maker, founded 1876, supplying 5G radio, core networks and managed services to operators in 180 countries. Revenue is about SEK 240 billion. Listed in Stockholm and on Nasdaq (ERIC). B2B but widely recognised brand, with a record of sports sponsorship. Ericsson employs about 95,000 people and competes with Huawei and Nokia, and it sponsors football and motorsport events.

wiki.title: Ericsson
wiki.text: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson, commonly known as Ericsson, is a Swedish multinational networking and telecommunications company headquartered in Stockholm. Ericsson has been a major contributor to the development of the telecommunications industry and is one of the leaders in 5G. Ericsson has over 57,000 granted patents, and it is the inventor of Bluetooth technology.

about: SGS is a Swiss inspection, verification, testing and certification company, headquartered in Geneva (Crunchbase shows Baar), founded in 1878 as a grain inspection firm, with about 100,000 employees and 2,600 offices and labs worldwide. Customers are manufacturers, retailers, governments and commodity traders, and revenue is about 6.6 billion Swiss francs. Listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (SGSN). B2B brand with little consumer awareness, though well known among suppliers and importers.

Zhejiang Century Huatong Group, based in Shaoxing, Zhejiang, is a Chinese technology and gaming group, listed in Shenzhen (002602) under the name Century Huatong. It develops and publishes online and mobile games, including Legend of Mir related titles through its Shanda Games and Archosaur affiliates, and operates internet and cloud services. Customers are game players mainly in China and overseas. Funding of about $429M was recorded in 2021. Games publishers are known to Chinese gamers, but the corporate brand has low global awareness.
cb_desc: Zhejiang Century Huatong Group engages in the....

about: Commonwealth Bank of Australia is Australia's largest bank by market value, providing retail, business and institutional banking, wealth management, insurance and the CommBank app to about 17 million customers, with a New Zealand arm (ASB). Headquartered in Sydney; founded 1911. Listed on the ASX (CBA). Dominant consumer bank brand in Australia and a major sports sponsor, including cricket and rugby league.

wiki.title: Commonwealth Bank
wiki.text: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA), also known as Commonwealth Bank or simply CommBank, is an Australian multinational bank with businesses across New Zealand, Asia, the United States and the United Kingdom. It provides a variety of financial services, including retail, business and institutional banking, funds management, superannuation, insurance, investment and broking services. The Commonwealth Bank is the largest Australian listed company on the Australian Securities Exchange as of July 2024, with brands including Bankwest, Colonial First State Investments, ASB Bank, Commonwealth Securities (CommSec) and Commonwealth Insurance (Com

about: BNP Paribas is the largest French bank and one of the biggest in the world, offering retail banking, corporate and institutional banking, asset management, insurance and leasing in about 65 countries, with total assets near 2.7 trillion euros and around 180,000 employees. Headquartered in Paris. Listed on Euronext Paris (BNP). Strong consumer brand in France, Belgium and Italy, and a long-standing tennis and rugby sponsor, including the Roland-Garros and the BNP Paribas Open.

wiki.title: BNP Paribas
wiki.what: French multinational banking and financial services company
wiki.text: BNP Paribas is a French multinational universal bank and financial services holding company headquartered in Paris. It was founded in 2000 from the merger of two of France's foremost financial institutions, Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) and Paribas. It also incorporates many other major institutions through successive acquisitions, including Fortis Bank in Belgium, Direkt Anlage Bank in Germany, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro in Italy, Banque Générale du Luxembourg in Luxembourg, and Türk Ekonomi Bankası in Turkey. The group also had a presence in the United States through its subsidiaries Bank of the West until 2023 and First Hawaiian Bank unt

about: DBS Bank is Southeast Asia's largest bank, offering consumer, SME and corporate banking, wealth management and digital banking (digibank) in Singapore, Hong Kong, China, India and Indonesia. Revenue near 22 billion Singapore dollars. Headquartered in Singapore; founded 1968; Singapore state investor Temasek holds about 29 percent of parent DBS Group Holdings. Listed on the Singapore Exchange (D05). Strong consumer brand in Singapore, and a sponsor of sports and marathons.

wiki.title: DBS Bank
wiki.what: Singaporean multinational banking and financial services company
wiki.text: DBS Bank Limited is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the Marina Bay Financial Centre in the Marina Bay district of Singapore. The bank was previously known as The Development Bank of Singapore Limited, which "DBS" was derived from, before the present abbreviated name was adopted on 21 July 2003 to reflect its role as a global bank. It is one of the "Big Three" local banks in Singapore, along with Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation (OCBC) and United Overseas Bank (UOB).

about: FIS (Fidelity National Information Services) is a Jacksonville, Florida fintech that provides banking and payments technology, including core banking systems, card processing, merchant acquiring and capital markets software for banks, credit unions, corporates and merchants worldwide. It employs about 50,000 people and generates revenue near $10bn. Listed on the NYSE (FIS). It bought Global Payments' issuer business in 2025 and sold much of Worldpay. B2B, widely known in financial circles though not to consumers.

wiki.title: FIS (company)
wiki.text: Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. (FIS) is an American financial technology company headquarterd in Jacksonville, Florida, which focuses on core banking, payments and capital markets. Annually, FIS facilitates the movement of roughly US$9 trillion through the processing of approximately 75 billion transactions in service to more than 20,000 clients around the globe.

about: Capital One is a McLean, Virginia bank holding company and one of the largest US credit card issuers, also offering auto loans, consumer and commercial banking, savings and the Discover network after buying Discover Financial in 2025. It serves over 100 million customers and has revenue above $50bn. Listed on the NYSE (COF). The brand is very familiar to US consumers from advertising, and it is a major sports sponsor, notably holding naming rights for the Capital One Arena, the Mastercard-linked Capital One Cup and Capital One Bowl.

wiki.title: Capital One
wiki.text: Capital One Financial Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, with operations in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It is one of the largest banks in the United States, one of the largest car finance companies in the United States, and is the largest issuer of credit cards in the United States. It owns the Discover Card, Diners Club, and Pulse payment networks. The company's three business segments are credit cards, consumer banking, and commercial banking. It has approximately 750 bank branches, including over 60 café style locations, and 7,000 ATMs in the United States. The company'

about: Bank of China is one of the Big Four Chinese state-owned banks, based in Beijing, founded in 1912, with operations in over 60 countries and total assets above 30 trillion yuan. It is China's most international bank, providing corporate, retail, foreign exchange and trade finance. Listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong (601988, 3988), controlled by the state. Very high brand awareness in China, and a sponsor of Olympic and sports events.

wiki.title: Bank of China
wiki.text: The Bank of China is a state-owned Chinese multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing, China. It is one of the "big four" banks in China. As of 31 December 2019, it was the second-largest lender in China overall and ninth-largest bank in the world by market capitalization value, and it is considered a systemically important bank by the Financial Stability Board. As of 2026, it was the fourth-largest bank in the world in terms of total assets, ranked after the other three Chinese banks.

about: Citi (Citigroup) is a New York-based global bank, founded in 1812, with services in banking, markets, wealth and US consumer cards (Citi Cards, Costco and Mastercard co-brands). It operates in about 160 countries with around 230,000 employees and is listed on NYSE (C). Customers are consumers, corporations, institutions and governments. Citibank retail banking and credit cards are household names in the US, and Citi sponsors tennis and other sports and events.

wiki.title: Citigroup
wiki.what: American multinational investment bank and financial services corporation
wiki.text: Citigroup Inc. or Citi is an American multinational investment bank and financial services company based in New York City. The company was formed in 1998 by the merger of Citicorp, the bank holding company for Citibank, and Travelers; Travelers was spun off from the company in 2002.

about: Groupe BPCE is a Paris-based French cooperative banking group, formed in 2009 from Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Epargne, and also owning Natixis and Credit Foncier. It serves about 36 million customers with retail banking, insurance and investment banking in France and abroad, with total assets above 1.3 trillion euros. Owned by its cooperative members. Strong brand in France, and a long-time sponsor in sports and Olympic partnership.

wiki.title: BPCE Group
wiki.text: BPCE is a major French banking group formed by the 2009 merger of two major retail banking groups, Groupe Caisse d'Épargne and Groupe Banque Populaire. As of 2025, it was France's third-largest bank, and the twenty-first in the world by total assets. It has more than 8,200 branches nationwide under their respective brand names serving nearly 150 million customers. Its wholesale banking subsidiary Natixis, previously a separately listed company, was delisted and came under full ownership of Groupe BPCE in 2021.

about: HSBC is a London-based global bank, founded in Hong Kong and Shanghai in 1865, serving about 40 million customers in around 60 countries with retail banking, wealth, commercial banking and global markets. Total assets are about $3 trillion. Listed in London, Hong Kong and New York (HSBA, 5, HSBC). Very high global brand awareness, and a major sponsor of sports including rugby sevens and golf.

wiki.title: HSBC
wiki.what: British bank and financial services group
wiki.text: HSBC Holdings plc is a British universal bank and financial services group headquartered in London, England, with historical and business links to East Asia and a multinational footprint. According to S&P Global's April 2026 report, HSBC is Europe's second-largest bank by assets, with $3.212 trillion in assets. This also puts it as the eighth-largest bank in the world by total assets and the third-largest non-state owned bank in the world.

about: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) is a Beijing-based state-owned bank and the world's largest bank by assets, at over 6 trillion dollars. It offers retail, corporate and international banking through about 16,000 branches in China and more than 40 countries. Listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong (601398, 1398), majority owned by the Chinese state. Very high brand awareness in China, and a long-term Olympic and sports sponsor.

wiki.title: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
wiki.text: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China is a Chinese partially state-owned multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing, China. It is the largest of the "big four" banks in China, and the largest bank in the world by total assets. ICBC was created on 4 January 1984 from what were then the commercial banking operations of the People's Bank of China. ICBC is majority-owned by the Chinese government and has remained so after its landmark initial public offering in 2006. As end of 2021, ICBC shareholders included Central Huijin Investment, the Chinese Ministry of Finance, the National Council for Social Se

about: QNB Group is a Doha-based Qatari bank, the largest in the Middle East and Africa by assets, owned about 50 percent by the Qatar Investment Authority and listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange (QNBK). It offers retail, corporate and wealth banking in about 28 countries, including Turkey (QNB Finansbank), Egypt and Indonesia. Strong brand in Qatar, and a sponsor of football and events such as the QNB Stars League.

wiki.title: QNB Group
wiki.text: Qatar National Bank Q.P.S.C. is a Qatari multinational commercial bank headquartered in Doha, Qatar. It was founded in 1964. The bank's ownership is evenly divided between the Qatar Investment Authority and members of the public.

about: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) is a Toronto-based bank, the largest in Canada by market capitalisation, offering personal and commercial banking, wealth management, insurance and capital markets in Canada, the US and 25 other countries. About 98,000 employees and assets above C$2 trillion. Listed on TSX and NYSE (RY). Very high brand awareness in Canada, a long-time sponsor of golf (RBC Canadian Open, RBC Heritage), tennis and the Olympics.

wiki.title: Royal Bank of Canada
wiki.text: The Royal Bank of Canada is a Canadian multinational financial services company and the largest bank in Canada by market capitalization. The bank serves over 19 million clients and has more than 101,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 1864 in Halifax, Nova Scotia, it maintains its corporate headquarters in Toronto and its head office in Montreal. RBC's institution number is 003. In November 2017, RBC was added to the Financial Stability Board's list of global systemically important banks.

about: AXA Group is a Paris-based global insurer, founded in 1985, offering property-casualty, health, life and asset management to about 93 million customers in 50 countries, with revenue of around 100 billion euros. Listed on Euronext Paris (CS). Very high consumer brand awareness in Europe, with long-standing sports sponsorship, including rugby and golf and, in the past, football.

wiki.title: Axa
wiki.text: Axa S.A. is a French multinational insurance company whose registered office is in the 8th arrondissement of Paris. It ranks among the largest insurers in the world by revenue and also sells assistance and related services through its subsidiaries. For 2025 the group reported gross written premiums and other revenues of €115.5 billion, more than 92 million customers in 52 countries and a workforce of about 156,000.

about: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA) is a Bilbao and Madrid-based Spanish bank with large operations in Mexico (BBVA Mexico), Turkey (Garanti BBVA), Spain and South America, serving about 80 million customers. Listed on the Madrid exchange and NYSE (BBVA). It owns the digital bank brand and has total assets above 800 billion euros. Very high consumer brand awareness in Spain and Mexico, with sports sponsorship including LaLiga and Liga MX.

wiki.title: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria
wiki.text: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A., better known by its initialism BBVA, is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Bilbao, with operative offices in Madrid. As one of the largest financial institutions globally, BBVA's core markets are primarily concentrated in Spain, Mexico, South America, and Turkey.

about: Bank of Montreal (BMO Financial Group) is one of Canada's five largest banks, founded in 1817 and headquartered in Toronto, with a registered office in Montreal. It offers personal and commercial banking, wealth management and capital markets, with a large US presence after acquiring Bank of the West in 2023 and BMO Harris Bank. It serves millions of retail and corporate clients and earns money from lending spreads, fees and investment services. Listed on the TSX and NYSE as BMO. Strong consumer brand in Canada and the US Midwest, and an existing sports sponsor (BMO Field, golf).

wiki.title: Bank of Montreal
wiki.text: The Bank of Montreal, abbreviated as BMO, is a Canadian multinational investment bank and financial services company.

about: Broadridge Financial Solutions is a fintech provider of investor communications, proxy voting, securities processing and wealth technology, spun off from ADP in 2007. Its platforms process trillions of dollars in daily trading volume for banks, broker-dealers, asset managers and public companies, with about 14,000 employees and revenue near 6.5 billion dollars. It is headquartered in Lake Success, New York, with offices worldwide, and is listed on the NYSE (BR). B2B infrastructure, little consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Broadridge Financial Solutions
wiki.text: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. is a public corporate services and financial technology company. Headquartered in Lake Success, New York, the company was founded in 2007 as a spin-off from Automatic Data Processing. Broadridge supplies companies in the financial industry with financial documents such as proxy statements and annual reports, as well as shareholder communications solutions such as virtual annual meetings.

about: CIBC (Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce) is one of Canada's Big Five banks, headquartered in Toronto, tracing its roots to 1867. It provides personal and business banking, credit cards, wealth management, capital markets and US commercial banking through CIBC Bank USA, serving over 10 million clients. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (CM), with revenue around 20 billion Canadian dollars. Revenue comes from lending spreads, fees and advisory work. Strong Canadian consumer brand with local sports and community sponsorships.

wiki.title: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce
wiki.text: The Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at CIBC Square in Toronto's Financial District. The Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce was formed through the 1961 merger of the Canadian Bank of Commerce and the Imperial Bank of Canada, in the largest merger between chartered banks in Canadian history. It is one of two "Big Five" banks founded in Toronto, the other being the Toronto-Dominion Bank.

about: CloudWalk is a Brazilian fintech headquartered in Sao Paulo that operates the InfinitePay payments business and the JIM.com platform, offering card machines, digital accounts, credit and merchant services to small and medium businesses. Founded in 2013, it has raised well over 300 million dollars from investors including Valor Capital and Redpoint, with a valuation above 2 billion dollars. Revenue comes from transaction fees, credit and account services. Strong brand among Brazilian small merchants, expanding in Latin America and the US.

wiki.title: CloudWalk Technology
wiki.text: CloudWalk Technology Co. Ltd. is a Chinese developer of facial recognition software.

wiki.title: CloudWalk (company)
wiki.text: CloudWalk is a Brazilian financial technology company based in São Paulo. It is considered a unicorn. The company operates primarily in Brazil through the financial services platform InfinitePay, launched in 2019, and internationally through the payment app JIM.com, aimed at the North American market.

about: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, headquartered in Frankfurt, founded in 1870 and listed on the NYSE and Frankfurt exchange (DB). It operates Corporate Bank, Investment Bank, Private Bank and DWS asset management, serving retail, corporate and institutional clients in about 60 countries with roughly 90,000 employees. Revenue comes from lending, trading, advisory and fees. Major global financial brand with a history of sports and cultural sponsorship, including partnerships in golf and football.

wiki.title: Deutsche Bank
wiki.what: German banking and financial services company
wiki.text: Deutsche Bank AG is a German multinational banking institution headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany. It is dual-listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange.

about: Dubai Islamic Bank is the world's first full-service Islamic bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Dubai, and the largest Islamic bank in the UAE by assets. It offers Sharia-compliant retail, corporate, wealth and treasury services, with branches across the UAE and operations in Pakistan, Kenya and elsewhere. Customers include individuals, SMEs and corporates; the Investment Corporation of Dubai is a major shareholder. Listed on the Dubai Financial Market. Strong regional consumer brand and an active sponsor in the Gulf.

wiki.title: Dubai Islamic Bank
wiki.text: Dubai Islamic Bank is a major Islamic bank headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Established in 1975 by Saeed bin Ahmed Lootah, it is the country's second largest lender. The bank follows Sharia principles across all its activities and is the largest Islamic bank in the United Arab Emirates by assets.

about: Emirates NBD is a leading banking group in the Middle East headquartered in Dubai, formed in 2007 from the merger of Emirates Bank and National Bank of Dubai, majority owned by Investment Corporation of Dubai. It provides retail, corporate, Islamic and private banking, including Liv digital bank and Network International-linked payments, with operations in UAE, Egypt, Turkey (DenizBank), India and Saudi Arabia. Listed on Dubai Financial Market. Strong regional consumer brand and prominent sponsor of sport and events in Dubai.

wiki.title: Emirates NBD
wiki.text: Emirates NBD Bank PJSC, is a major Emirati bank among the Big Four banks.

about: Erste Group is a leading Austrian banking group headquartered in Vienna, with about 16 million customers in Austria, Czechia, Slovakia, Romania, Hungary, Croatia and Serbia through brands like Erste Bank, Ceska sporitelna and Slovenska sporitelna. It provides retail, corporate and capital markets banking, with about 45,000 employees and listing on Vienna Stock Exchange (EBS). Founded 1819. Strong consumer brand in Central and Eastern Europe, involved in sports and arts sponsorship.

wiki.title: Erste Group
wiki.text: Erste Group Bank AG is an Austrian financial service provider. It is one of the largest financial service providers in Central and Eastern Europe serving more than 23 million clients in over 2,000 branches in eight countries. Erste Group is headquartered in Vienna and operates as a universal bank.

about: ICICI Bank is one of India's largest private sector banks, headquartered in Mumbai (registered in Vadodara), serving retail, SME and corporate customers through roughly 6,500 branches and over 16,000 ATMs, plus mobile apps such as iMobile Pay. It has international branches and subsidiaries in the UK, Canada and Singapore. It also owns ICICI Prudential insurance and mutual fund joint ventures. Founded 1994, listed on NSE, BSE and NYSE (IBN). Very strong consumer brand across India and an existing sports sponsor.

wiki.title: ICICI Bank
wiki.text: ICICI Bank is an Indian multinational private bank and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai.It was established in 1955 at the initiative of the World Bank, the Government of India and representatives of Indian industry. It offers services to corporate and retail customers, and has subsidiaries for investment banking, life and non-life insurance, venture capital, and asset management.

about: ING Group is a Dutch banking and financial services group headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Euronext Amsterdam and the NYSE (INGA). It serves around 40 million customers across more than 100 countries with retail and direct banking, notably in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Poland and Australia, plus wholesale banking for corporates. Revenue comes from lending margins and fees, with roughly 60,000 employees. Strong consumer brand in Europe with long track record in sport and cultural sponsorship.

wiki.title: ING Group
wiki.what: Dutch multinational banking and financial services corporation
wiki.text: The ING Group is a Dutch multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Amsterdam. Its primary businesses are retail banking, direct banking, commercial banking, investment banking, wholesale banking, private banking, and asset management. With total assets of €1,316 billion, it consistently ranks among the largest banks globally.

about: Intesa Sanpaolo is Italy's largest banking group, headquartered in Turin with offices in Milan, formed in 2007 through the merger of Banca Intesa and Sanpaolo IMI. It serves around 13 million customers in Italy through retail, private, corporate and wealth management, with banking subsidiaries across Central and Eastern Europe and Egypt. Listed on Borsa Italiana (ISP) and employing over 90,000 people. Strong Italian consumer brand with extensive sponsorship in arts and sport.

wiki.title: Intesa Sanpaolo
wiki.text: Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. is an Italian international banking group. It is Italy's largest bank by total assets and the world's 38th largest. It was formed through the merger of the Milan-based Banca Intesa and Turin-based Sanpaolo IMI in 2007, but has a corporate identity stretching back to its first foundation as Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino in 1583. It has two headquarters: Milan, which houses the headquarters of IMI-Corporate and Investment Banking Division, International Banks Division, Private Banking Division, Asset Management Division and Insurance Division, and Turin, which houses Banca dei Territori, the retail banking Divisio

about: Macquarie Group is an Australian global financial services group headquartered in Sydney and listed on the ASX (MQG), operating in about 30 markets with roughly 20,000 employees. Businesses cover asset management (Macquarie Asset Management), banking and financial services, commodities and global markets, and Macquarie Capital advisory. It owns and invests in infrastructure and renewable assets, with annual income around 17 billion Australian dollars. Founded 1969. Strong corporate brand, with sponsorship history in Australian sport and events.

wiki.title: Macquarie Group
wiki.what: Australian investment bank and financial services company
wiki.text: Macquarie Group Limited, more commonly known as Macquarie Bank, is an Australian multinational investment banking and financial services group headquartered in Sydney and listed on the Australian Securities Exchange. The company employs more than 20,000 staff across four operating groups in 34 markets.

about: Mizuho Financial Group is one of Japan's three megabanks, headquartered in Tokyo (Otemachi) and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and NYSE (MFG). It operates Mizuho Bank, Mizuho Trust and Mizuho Securities, serving individuals, corporations and institutions in Japan and around 35 countries with roughly 60,000 employees. Revenue comes from lending, securities and asset management. Formed in 2000 from the merger of Dai-Ichi Kangyo, Fuji and Industrial Bank of Japan. Strong Japanese consumer brand with sport and cultural sponsorships.

wiki.title: Mizuho Financial Group
wiki.text: The Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. , known from 2000 to 2003 as Mizuho Holdings and abbreviated as MHFG or simply Mizuho, is a Japanese banking holding company headquartered in the Ōtemachi district of Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan. The group was formed in 2000–2002 by merger of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Fuji Bank, and Industrial Bank of Japan. The name mizuho (瑞穂) literally means "abundant rice" in Japanese and "harvest" in the figurative sense.

about: National Australia Bank (NAB) is one of Australia's big four banks, headquartered in Melbourne and listed on the ASX (NAB). It serves around 10 million customers with personal, business and corporate banking, wealth management and institutional banking in Australia and New Zealand (BNZ), and has a large business banking franchise. Founded 1858 with about 38,000 employees. Strong consumer brand in Australia and an existing sports and cultural sponsor, including the AFL.

wiki.title: National Australia Bank
wiki.text: National Australia Bank Limited is one of the four largest financial institutions in Australia in terms of market capitalisation, earnings and customers. NAB was ranked the world's 21st-largest bank measured by market capitalisation and 52nd-largest bank in the world as measured by total assets in 2019.

about: OCBC Bank (Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation) is the second-largest bank in Southeast Asia by assets, headquartered in Singapore and listed on the Singapore Exchange (O39). It provides consumer, SME and corporate banking, wealth management through Bank of Singapore, and insurance via Great Eastern, with a network across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Greater China and others. Founded 1932 through a merger of three banks. Strong consumer brand in Singapore with a long history of sports and community sponsorship, including cycling and golf.

wiki.title: OCBC Bank
wiki.what: Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation
wiki.text: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited, abbreviated as OCBC, is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the OCBC Centre. As of the end of 2024, it had S$625.1 billion in assets, making it the second largest bank in Southeast Asia by assets. Globally it operates over 400 branches and representative offices in 19 countries including Malaysia, Indonesia, mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau under subsidiaries OCBC Bank (Malaysia) Berhad, PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk, OCBC China Limited, OCBC Bank Limited and OCBC Bank (Macau) Limited respectively.

about: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMFG) is one of Japan's three megabanks, headquartered in Tokyo and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and NYSE (SMFG). It runs Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, SMBC Nikko Securities, SMBC Consumer Finance and Sumitomo Mitsui Card, with large operations in Asia and stakes in Jefferies and Indian lender Yes Bank. Employs more than 100,000 people. Founded 2002. Strong Japanese consumer brand and a major sponsor in sport and culture, including golf and tennis.

wiki.title: SMBC Group
wiki.text: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. (株式会社三井住友フィナンシャルグループ), initialed as SMFG until 2018 and SMBC Group since, is a major Japanese multinational financial services group and holding company. It is the parent of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC), SMBC Trust Bank, and SMBC Nikko Securities. SMBC originates from the 2001 merger of Sumitomo Bank with the Sakura Bank, itself a successor to the Mitsui Bank, and the group holding entity was created in December 2002 after which SMBC became its wholly owned subsidiary.

about: Toronto-Dominion Bank (TD Bank Group) is one of Canada's Big Five banks, headquartered in Toronto, with large US operations as TD Bank, America's Most Convenient Bank. It offers retail, commercial, wealth, insurance and capital markets services to over 27 million customers, and is listed on the TSX and NYSE (TD). Assets exceed 2 trillion Canadian dollars and it has about 100,000 employees. Founded 1955. Strong consumer brand across Canada and the US east coast, with large sponsorships including TD Garden.

wiki.title: Toronto-Dominion Bank
wiki.what: Canadian bank and financial services corporation
wiki.text: Toronto-Dominion Bank, doing business as TD Bank Group, and commonly known as just TD, is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. The bank was created on February 1, 1955, through the merger of the Bank of Toronto and the Dominion Bank, which were founded in 1855 and 1869, respectively. It is one of two Big Five banks of Canada founded in Toronto, the other being the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.

about: United Overseas Bank (UOB) is one of the three Singapore banking groups, headquartered in Singapore and listed on the Singapore Exchange (U11). It provides personal, SME, corporate, wealth and private banking across Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam) and Greater China, with over 500 branches. Founded 1935. Employs about 28,000 people, with annual income around 14 billion Singapore dollars. Strong consumer brand in Southeast Asia, a major arts and sports sponsor in Singapore.

wiki.title: United Overseas Bank
wiki.text: United Overseas Bank Limited, often known as UOB, is a Singaporean regional bank headquartered at Raffles Place, Singapore, with branches mostly found in Southeast Asia countries. It is one of the three "big local banks" in the country, the other two being DBS Bank and Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation (OCBC).

about: Ant Group is the Chinese fintech giant behind Alipay, headquartered in Hangzhou and affiliated with Alibaba founder Jack Ma. It operates a payments app used by over a billion people, plus wealth management (Fund Sales), credit (Huabei, Jiebei), insurance, MYbank and international payments such as Alipay+ and Ant International. Revenue is over 100 billion yuan. Spun from Alibaba in 2014; its 2020 IPO was halted by regulators. Privately held. Very strong consumer brand in China and widely used by Chinese tourists abroad.

wiki.title: Ant Group
wiki.text: Ant Group, formerly known as Ant Financial, is an affiliate company of the Chinese conglomerate Alibaba Group. Ant Group was initially the financial transaction arm of Alibaba, Alipay, when it was set up in 2004.

about: SoFi Technologies is a US digital financial services company offering student loan refinancing, personal loans, home loans, a checking and savings account, credit card, investing and crypto trading, plus the Galileo and Technisys platforms for other fintechs. It has over 12 million members and holds a national bank charter after buying Golden Pacific Bancorp in 2022. Headquartered in San Francisco, listed on Nasdaq (SOFI) via a 2021 SPAC merger. Strong consumer brand and naming-rights holder of SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.

wiki.title: SoFi
wiki.text: SoFi Technologies, Inc. is an American financial technology company. Founded in 2011 by Stanford University graduates as a student loan refinancier, it operates a direct bank serving retail customers and businesses. SoFi is the largest U.S.-based online lender, and has over 17 million customers as of 2026.

about: Bank of America is one of the largest US banks, offering consumer banking, credit and debit cards, mortgages, small business banking, wealth management through Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank, and corporate and investment banking through BofA Securities. It serves tens of millions of customers, with about 3,700 branches and total assets of over $3 trillion. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. Listed on NYSE (BAC). Very strong consumer brand, a long-time naming-rights holder and sponsor of sports, golf, soccer and the Chicago Marathon.

wiki.title: Bank of America
wiki.what: American multinational banking and financial services corporation
wiki.text: The Bank of America Corporation is an American multinational bank and financial services holding company headquartered at the Bank of America Corporate Center in Charlotte, North Carolina, with investment banking and auxiliary headquarters in Manhattan. The bank was formed by the merger of NationsBank and the legacy corporation of Bank of America in 1998. It is the second-largest banking institution in the United States by consolidated assets, after JPMorgan Chase. It is also the second-largest bank in the world by market capitalization, after JPMorgan Chase.

about: EQT is a Stockholm-based global investment firm running private equity, infrastructure, real estate, growth and venture funds, with about 270 billion euros in assets under management and portfolio companies across Europe, North America and Asia. Customers are institutional investors such as pension funds and sovereign funds, with revenue from management fees and carried interest. Founded in 1994 with roots in the Wallenberg family's Investor AB. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (EQT) since 2019. Well-known in finance, low consumer awareness.

Global Payments is a merchant payments technology company headquartered in Atlanta, offering card acceptance, point-of-sale software, issuer processing and commerce tools to millions of businesses and financial institutions worldwide. It merged with TSYS in 2019 and, in 2025, agreed to buy Worldpay while selling its Issuer Solutions business to FIS. Revenue is about $10 billion. Listed on NYSE (GPN). B2B brand, known in banking and retail, with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Global Payments
wiki.text: Global Payments Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company that provides payment technology to merchants, issuers and consumers. In June 2021, the company was named to the Fortune 500. The company processes payments made through credit cards, debit cards, and digital and contactless payments.

about: Kuwait Finance House (KFH) is one of the world's largest Islamic banks, offering Shariah-compliant retail, corporate, investment and real estate finance in Kuwait, Bahrain, Turkey, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia and elsewhere. Founded in 1977 and headquartered in Kuwait City, it merged with Ahli United Bank in 2022 and is a pioneer in Islamic banking. Listed on Boursa Kuwait (KFH). Strong consumer brand in Kuwait and the Gulf with significant advertising and sponsorship.

wiki.title: Kuwait Finance House
wiki.text: Kuwait Finance House (KFH) is a Kuwaiti bank, founded in 1977, as the first bank operating in accordance with the Islamic Shari'a rulings. KFH is listed on the Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE).

about: BTG Pactual is Latin America's largest independent investment bank, offering investment banking, asset management, wealth management, trading, research and a retail digital bank, with operations across Brazil, Latin America, the US and Europe. Headquartered in Sao Paulo, founded in 1983, and led by Andre Esteves. Customers are institutions, wealthy individuals and mass-market digital users. Listed on B3 (BPAC11). Strong finance brand in Brazil, with sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: BTG Pactual
wiki.text: BTG Pactual is a global financial services group headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. Founded in Rio de Janeiro in 1983, it has regional bank operations in 13 major financial centers and operations across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. With over US$500 billion in assets across wealth and asset management, BTG Pactual offers services in investment banking, wealth management, asset management, corporate lending, sales and trading, and consumer banking. Its shares are traded on the B3 in São Paulo.

about: National Bank of Canada is Canada's sixth-largest bank, offering personal and commercial banking, wealth management, and capital markets, with a strong base in Quebec and a financial markets business that includes Credigy in the US and ABA Bank in Cambodia. Headquartered in Montreal, founded in 1859. Listed on the TSX (NA). Strong consumer brand in Quebec and sponsor of the National Bank Open tennis tournament.

wiki.title: National Bank of Canada
wiki.text: The National Bank of Canada is the sixth largest commercial bank in Canada. It is headquartered in Montreal, and has branches in most Canadian provinces and 3.1 million clients. National Bank is the largest bank in Quebec, and the second largest financial institution in the province after Desjardins. National Bank's institution number is 006, and the SWIFT code is BNDCCAMMINT.

about: ANZ (Australia and New Zealand Banking Group) is one of Australia's big four banks, headquartered in Melbourne, providing retail, business and institutional banking in Australia, New Zealand and across Asia and the Pacific. It has about 40,000 staff and serves around 8 million customers, and is listed on the ASX (ANZ). Total assets exceed one trillion Australian dollars. Very high consumer visibility in Australia and New Zealand, and a major sports sponsor including rugby, cricket and the Australian Open.

Bank of Ireland is one of Ireland's biggest retail and commercial banks, headquartered in Dublin, providing current accounts, mortgages, business lending, life insurance and wealth services through branches and digital channels. It is listed on Euronext Dublin and the London Stock Exchange (BIRG) and founded in 1783. Customers are Irish households and businesses. Very high consumer visibility in Ireland, including sponsorship of rugby and Gaelic games.

wiki.title: Bank of Ireland
wiki.text: Bank of Ireland Group plc is a commercial bank operation in Ireland and one of the traditional Big Four Irish banks. Historically the premier banking organisation in Ireland, the bank occupies a unique position in Irish banking history. At the core of the modern-day group is the old Governor and Company of the Bank of Ireland, the ancient institution established by royal charter in 1783.

about: SumUp is a London-based fintech that provides card readers, point-of-sale systems, online payments, invoicing and business accounts for small merchants, operating in more than 30 markets across Europe, the Americas and beyond. Founded in 2012 in Germany, it has served millions of merchants and raised billions of dollars in equity and debt, with a valuation of over 8 billion euros in 2022. Strong B2B brand among small businesses, backed by heavy advertising, and a sponsor of sports properties.

wiki.title: SumUp
wiki.text: SumUp is a British financial technology company headquartered in London. SumUp’s primary product is an EMV card reader and a number of online payment and bank account system for merchants and businesses.

about: Bank Mandiri is Indonesia's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Jakarta and majority-owned by the Indonesian government, listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BMRI). It offers retail, corporate, SME and digital banking, including the Livin' by Mandiri app, with tens of millions of customers and a presence in Singapore, Hong Kong and elsewhere. A familiar household brand in Indonesia and active in sport and sponsorship locally.

wiki.title: Bank Mandiri
wiki.text: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk or Bank Mandiri, headquartered in Jakarta, is the largest bank in Indonesia in terms of assets, loans and deposits as of 2014. Total assets as of 2025, were Rp. 2.829 trillion. As of 2022, Bank Mandiri is the largest bank in Indonesia by total assets.

about: Garanti BBVA is one of Turkey's largest private banks, headquartered in Istanbul and majority-owned by Spain's BBVA. It provides retail, SME, corporate and digital banking, with several hundred branches, tens of millions of customers, and assets of the order of tens of billions of dollars. Listed on Borsa Istanbul (GARAN). It has long been a sponsor of Turkish sport and arts, and is a household brand in Turkey.

wiki.title: Garanti BBVA
wiki.text: Garanti BBVA is a Turkish financial services company based in Turkey. 86% of Garanti's stakes are owned by the Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA).

about: National Bank of Kuwait (NBK) is Kuwait's first and largest bank, founded in 1952 and headquartered in Kuwait City, listed on Boursa Kuwait. It provides retail, corporate, private and investment banking, with operations across the Gulf, the Middle East, Europe, and the US, and a large customer base. NBK is known for strong credit ratings and sponsors cultural and sporting events. It has a high-profile brand across the region.

wiki.title: National Bank of Kuwait
wiki.text: The National Bank of Kuwait (NBK) is a multinational bank headquartered in Kuwait City. It was established in 1952 and operates 142 branches across 13 countries, at least seven of which are in the Middle East. It also offers alternative investments through its NBK Capital subsidiary, which, since its establishment in 2005, has allocated over $91 billion worth of investment banking mandates as of November 2022.

about: Credit Agricole is a French cooperative banking group, headquartered in Montrouge near Paris, one of the largest banks in Europe, with retail banking through regional banks and LCL, asset management through Amundi, insurance and corporate banking. It serves tens of millions of customers worldwide and is listed on Euronext Paris through Credit Agricole SA. A major household brand in France that has sponsored cycling and other sports.

wiki.title: Crédit Agricole
wiki.text: Crédit Agricole Group, sometimes called La banque verte, is a French international banking group and the world's largest cooperative financial institution.

about: iCapital is a New York-based fintech, founded in 2013, that offers a platform for wealth managers, banks and asset managers to access and distribute alternative investments such as private equity and hedge funds to high-net-worth clients. It earns platform and servicing fees and has raised about $1.5 billion at a valuation of about $7.5 billion, with backers including BlackRock and UBS. B2B, strong among wealth advisers, but low general public awareness.

wiki.title: ICapital
wiki.text: Institutional Capital Network, Inc is an American fintech company that provides platform solutions related to alternative investments in the private markets.

about: Julius Baer Group is a Swiss private banking group based in Zurich, listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (BAER), that manages about 500 billion Swiss francs of client assets for wealthy individuals worldwide, with offices in Switzerland, Asia, the Middle East and Europe. It earns advisory, custody and asset management fees. Well known as a luxury wealth manager and a sponsor of tennis, sailing and Formula E-style events.

wiki.title: Julius Baer Group
wiki.text: Julius Baer Group Ltd. is a Swiss multinational private banking and financial services firm headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Specializing in wealth management, investment advisory services, real estate financing, and selective trading services, it is one of the world’s largest dedicated private banks, with CHF 497.4 billion in managed assets as of 2024. It is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and is a constituent of the Swiss Market Index Mid.

about: OTP Bank is Hungary's largest independent banking group, headquartered in Budapest and listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange (OTP). It provides retail, SME and corporate banking in Hungary and a number of Central and Eastern European countries, including Bulgaria, Croatia, Serbia, Slovenia, Ukraine and Uzbekistan. It serves more than 17 million customers. It has strong consumer brand recognition across the region and sponsors sport and cultural events.

wiki.title: OTP Bank
wiki.text: OTP Bank Group is the largest commercial bank of Hungary and one of the largest independent financial service providers in Central and Eastern Europe, with banking services for private individuals and corporate clients. The OTP Group comprises subsidiaries in the field of insurance, real estate, factoring, leasing and asset management, investment and pension funds. Besides Hungary, OTP Group operates in 10 countries of the region via its subsidiaries: in Albania, in Bulgaria, in Croatia, in Serbia, in Slovenia, in Ukraine, in Moldova, in Montenegro, in Russia, and in Uzbekistan.

about: Plaid is a San Francisco financial technology company, founded in 2013, whose software lets consumers connect bank accounts to apps like Venmo, Robinhood and Coinbase, and supplies data, payments and identity services to developers and banks. It earns fees from companies using its API, and reached a valuation of about $6 billion after raising about $1.3 billion. Visa's 2020 $5.3 billion purchase was abandoned. B2B, but widely seen by consumers in the Plaid Link screen.

wiki.title: Plaid Inc.
wiki.text: Plaid Inc. is an American financial services company based in San Francisco, California. The company builds a data transfer network that powers fintech and digital finance products.

about: Scotiabank is Canada's third-largest bank by assets, headquartered in Toronto and listed on the Toronto and New York exchanges (BNS), with major businesses in Canada, Mexico, Chile, Peru and Colombia. It provides retail, commercial, wealth and corporate banking to about 25 million customers. It has deep ties to hockey, as sponsor of the NHL and the Scotiabank Arena, and is a high-profile Canadian consumer brand.

wiki.title: Scotiabank
wiki.what: Canadian multinational bank headquartered in Toronto
wiki.text: The Bank of Nova Scotia, operating as Scotiabank, is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. One of Canada's Big Five banks, it is the third-largest Canadian bank by assets and deposits. In 2023, the company's seat in Forbes Global 2000 was 88. Scotiabank serves over 25 million customers globally, offering personal and commercial banking, wealth management, corporate and investment services. With 88,000 employees and assets of approximately $1.5 trillion as of January 31, 2026, Scotiabank trades on the Toronto and New York stock exchanges under the symbol BNS. Scotiabank's institution

about: Talanx is a Hanover-based German insurance group, the parent of HDI and Hannover Re, one of the world's largest reinsurers. It offers industrial, retail and reinsurance cover in over 175 countries, and is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (TLX). Premium income is in the tens of billions of euros. Retail brand HDI is known in Germany and Latin America; Talanx itself is mainly B2B.

wiki.title: Talanx
wiki.text: Talanx is a German multinational financial services company headquartered in Hanover, Germany. Its core businesses include reinsurance, insurance and asset management. Talanx is Germany's third-largest insurance group and one of the major European insurance groups by premium income. The group operates in more than 150 countries.

about: Mashreq Bank is a Dubai-headquartered bank founded in 1967, one of the UAE's largest private banks, listed on the Dubai Financial Market. It provides retail, corporate and investment banking, with a digital neobank (Mashreq NEO) and operations in Egypt, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and London. It is controlled by the Al Ghurair family. A strong UAE consumer brand that sponsors sport and culture.

wiki.title: Mashreq (bank)
wiki.text: Mashreq is a major Emirati bank, one of the oldest in the country and the second in the Middle East. Established in 1967 as the Bank of Oman, the bank later rebranded as Mashreq and has since expanded its operations across multiple markets.

about: Westpac is one of Australia's big four banks, headquartered in Sydney and founded in 1817 as the Bank of New South Wales, listed on the ASX (WBC). It provides retail, business and institutional banking and wealth services in Australia and New Zealand, with about 13 million customers. Strong consumer brand and long-time sponsor of sport and community events.

wiki.title: Westpac
wiki.text: Westpac Banking Corporation is an Australian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered at Westpac Place in Sydney.

about: Banco do Brasil is Brazil's largest bank by assets, majority state-owned by the federal government, headquartered in Brasilia, with retail, corporate, agribusiness and investment banking, and tens of millions of customers through thousands of branches. Founded in 1808, it is listed on the B3 exchange (BBAS3). One of the best-known consumer brands in Brazil and a long-time major sponsor of sport, notably volleyball and football.

wiki.title: Banco do Brasil
wiki.text: Banco do Brasil S.A. is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in Brasília, Brazil. The oldest bank in Brazil, and among the oldest banks in continuous operation in the world, it was founded by John VI, King of Portugal, on Wednesday, 12 October 1808. It is the second largest banking institution in Brazil, as well as the second largest in Latin America. Banco do Brasil is controlled by the Brazilian government and is listed at the B3 stock exchange in São Paulo.

about: Ziraat Bank (Turkiye Cumhuriyeti Ziraat Bankasi) is Turkey's largest state-owned bank, headquartered in Ankara, with a branch network of over 1,700 and large retail, agricultural, SME and corporate banking, as well as international branches. Owned by the Turkey Wealth Fund, founded in 1863. A very well-known consumer bank in Turkey and a long-standing sponsor of Turkish sports, including football.

wiki.title: Ziraat Bank
wiki.text: Ziraat Bankası is a Turkish public bank founded in 1863. The bank provides commercial loan support to companies and tradesmen, as well as personal loans such as consumer loans, vehicle loans and housing loans.

about: Gulf International Bank (GIB) is a Bahrain-based wholesale bank, headquartered in Manama, owned by the six Gulf Cooperation Council states with the Saudi Public Investment Fund as the largest shareholder, offering corporate, investment, treasury and asset management services, including GIB Capital in Riyadh. Founded in 1975. Crunchbase shows about $1.4 billion in funding. B2B bank with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Gulf International Bank
wiki.text: Gulf International Bank (GIB) is a bank established in 1976. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Bahrain and headquartered in Manama in Bahrain.

about: Northern Trust is a Chicago-based financial institution founded in 1889, providing asset servicing, wealth management, asset management and banking to institutions and wealthy individuals, with over $1 trillion in assets under management and trillions under custody. About 23,000 employees worldwide. Listed on Nasdaq (NTRS). Well known in institutional finance and a long-standing golf sponsor, having backed the PGA Tour's Northern Trust playoff event.

wiki.title: Northern Trust
wiki.text: Northern Trust Corporation is an American financial services company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, that caters to corporations, institutional investors, and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Northern Trust is one of the largest banking institutions in the United States and one of the oldest banks in continuous operation. As of December 31, 2025, it had $1.8 trillion in assets under management and $14.9 trillion in assets under custody. Northern Trust Corporation is incorporated in Delaware.

about: Raymond James Financial is a St. Petersburg, Florida financial services firm offering wealth management, investment banking, asset management and banking, with over 8,000 financial advisors and about $1.5 trillion in client assets. Revenue exceeds $12 billion. Listed on the NYSE (RJF). It holds the naming rights to Raymond James Stadium, home of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, and is an established US sports sponsor.

wiki.title: Raymond James Financial
wiki.what: American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company
wiki.text: Raymond James Financial, Inc. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company providing financial services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities through its subsidiary companies that engage primarily in investment and financial planning, in addition to investment banking and asset management. The company is headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida.

about: ABN AMRO Bank is a Dutch bank based in Amsterdam, with retail, private and corporate banking and a strong position in the Netherlands, and around 20,000 employees. The Dutch state held a majority stake after a 2008 bail-out and has been reducing it, with shares on Euronext Amsterdam (ABN). In 2025 it agreed to buy NIBC. Recognisable Dutch consumer brand and long-time sponsor of events including tennis in Rotterdam.

wiki.title: ABN AMRO
wiki.text: ABN AMRO Bank N.V. is the third-largest Dutch bank, with headquarters in Amsterdam. It was initially formed in 1991 by merger of the two prior Dutch banks that form its name, Algemene Bank Nederland (ABN) and Amsterdamsche en Rotterdamsche Bank.

about: Standard Bank Group is Africa's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Johannesburg, with retail, business and corporate banking in South Africa and about 20 countries across Africa, and a Chinese ICBC stake historically. Founded in 1862 and listed on the JSE (SBK). Millions of customers. Highly recognised financial brand across Africa, a sponsor of sport, music and the arts.

wiki.title: Standard Bank
wiki.text: Standard Bank is the largest bank in Africa, as well as the continent's largest lender by assets, holding a total of R3.8 trillion in assets in 2026.

about: Maybank (Malayan Banking Berhad) is Malaysia's largest bank, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, providing retail, commercial, investment and Islamic banking, insurance and asset management in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and other ASEAN markets, serving about 22 million customers. Founded 1960, listed on Bursa Malaysia (MAYBANK). Major consumer brand across ASEAN with extensive sports and cultural sponsorship, including football and golf.

wiki.title: Maybank
wiki.text: Malayan Banking Berhad is a Malaysian universal bank, with key operating "home markets" of Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. According to the 2020 Brand Finance report, Maybank is Malaysia's most valuable bank brand, the fourth-top brand amongst the ASEAN countries and ranked 70th among the world's most valuable bank brands.

about: Deutsche Boerse Group, based in Eschborn near Frankfurt, operates the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, the Eurex derivatives exchange, Xetra electronic trading, Clearstream post-trade services, the 360T foreign exchange platform and the STOXX and DAX index businesses. Customers are banks, brokers, asset managers and corporates, and revenue comes from trading, clearing, settlement, custody and market data fees. It has around 15,000 employees and is listed in Frankfurt (DB1) and part of the DAX index. It is B2B with moderate brand awareness among investors.
flags: name read with low OCR confidence: check spelling

wiki.title: Deutsche Börse
wiki.text: Deutsche Börse AG, or the Deutsche Börse Group, is a German multinational corporation that offers a marketplace for organizing the trading of shares and other securities. It is also a transaction services provider, giving companies and investors access to global capital markets. Founded in 1992, it is a joint stock company headquartered in Frankfurt. It is the third-largest stock market in Europe by market cap after Euronext Paris and the London Stock Exchange.

about: Helvetia Baloise Holding AG is a Basel based insurer formed by the 2025 merger of Helvetia and Baloise, creating one of Switzerland's largest insurance groups. It provides non-life, life, pension and reinsurance products to private and business customers in Switzerland, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Austria, Belgium and Luxembourg. It has roughly 20,000 employees and premium volume above 20 billion francs. It is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (HBAN). Both brands are well known domestically and were sponsors of Swiss sport.

Wolters Kluwer is a Dutch global information services and software company serving legal, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance and healthcare professionals. Products include CCH tax software, UpToDate clinical decision support, Kluwer legal publications and Enablon compliance tools. It sells subscriptions and software to businesses, hospitals and professionals worldwide with roughly 6 billion euros of revenue and about 21,000 employees. Headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn and listed on Euronext Amsterdam (WKL). B2B brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Wolters Kluwer
wiki.text: Wolters Kluwer N.V. is a Dutch multinational company that provides information, software, and services for accountants, doctors, lawyers, and other professionals. The company serves legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare markets.

about: Nordea is the largest Nordic financial services group, offering retail, private, corporate and investment banking and asset management in Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden, with around 10 million customers and 28,000 staff. It was founded through mergers in the 1990s and 2000s and moved its HQ from Stockholm to Helsinki in 2018. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki, Stockholm and Copenhagen (NDA). Strong Nordic consumer brand with sports sponsorships.

wiki.title: Nordea
wiki.text: Nordea Bank Abp, commonly referred to as Nordea, is a Nordic financial services group operating in northern Europe with headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. The name is a blend of the words "Nordic" and "idea". The Nordic countries are considered Nordea's home market, following the sale of its Polish business in 2014, the divestment of its Baltic operations in 2019, and its exit from Russia in 2022. Nordea is listed on Nasdaq Nordic exchanges in Helsinki, Copenhagen, and Stockholm, while its American Depository Receipts are traded in the US.

about: FirstRand is South Africa's largest financial services group by market value, owning First National Bank (FNB), Rand Merchant Bank, WesBank and Discovery stakes, serving retail, commercial and corporate customers across South Africa and Africa. Based in Johannesburg and listed on the JSE (FSR). FNB is a leading consumer bank, and the group has a high profile in South African sport.

wiki.title: FirstRand
wiki.text: FirstRand Limited, also referred to as FirstRand Group, is the holding company of FirstRand Bank, and is a financial services provider in South Africa. It is one of the financial services providers licensed by the Reserve Bank of South Africa, the national banking regulator. FirstRand Group is Africa’s largest listed financial services institution, with over R1.7 trillion in assets under management (AUM) across Africa, the UK, and India.

about: Commerzbank is Germany's second-largest listed bank after Deutsche Bank, serving private and small-business customers and mid-sized corporate clients, with some 10 million private customers. Based in Frankfurt, and listed on the Frankfurt exchange (CBK). The German state holds about 12%, and UniCredit has built a stake. Well known to German consumers, and a former sponsor of Eintracht Frankfurt and football stadium naming.

wiki.title: Commerzbank
wiki.text: The Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft is a European banking institution headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany. It offers services to private, business and corporate customers. The Commerzbank Group also includes the Polish subsidiary mBank.

about: SEB (Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken) is a leading Nordic corporate and investment bank, founded in 1856 by the Wallenberg family and headquartered in Stockholm. It serves large corporates, financial institutions and private customers in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland and the Baltics, plus Germany, with about 20,000 employees and around 2,000 billion Swedish kronor in loans. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (SEB A), with the Wallenberg-linked foundations as the main shareholder. Recognized financial brand in Scandinavia and a sponsor of sport and tennis.

Banco Sabadell is a Spanish banking group, founded in 1881 in Sabadell, Catalonia, with headquarters moved to Alicante in 2017, providing retail, SME, corporate and private banking, insurance and TSB in the UK (acquired 2015). It has about 20,000 employees and operates in Spain, the UK and Mexico, with assets of more than 250 billion euros. Listed on the Spanish stock exchange (SAB). In 2024-2025 it rejected a takeover bid from BBVA. Consumer banking brand with strong Spanish recognition and sponsorships in sport.

wiki.title: Banco Sabadell
wiki.text: Banco de Sabadell, S.A. is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Sabadell, Catalonia. It is the 4th-largest Spanish banking group. It includes several banks, brands, subsidiaries and associated banks. It is a universal bank and specialises in serving small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and the affluent with a bias towards international trade.

about: ITOCHU Corporation is a Tokyo general trading company (sogo shosha) with businesses in textiles, machinery, metals, energy, food (Dole Asia, FamilyMart), and ICT, supporting a global network. Revenue is about 13 trillion yen. Founded in 1858, it is listed in Tokyo (8001) and is backed by Warren Buffett's Berkshire. Its FamilyMart convenience stores give it a visible Japanese retail presence, while the group is largely B2B.

wiki.title: Itochu
wiki.text: Itochu Corporation is a Japanese corporation based in Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka and Aoyama, Minato, Tokyo.

about: Wise is a London fintech with international money transfer, multi-currency accounts and debit cards, serving about 15 million active customers and handling more than 100 billion pounds of volume a year with revenue of around 1.2 billion pounds. Founded as TransferWise in 2011 by Taavet Hinrikus and Kristo Kaarmann, it listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2021 and plans to move its primary listing to the US. A strong consumer brand with global sports sponsorship, including McLaren in Formula 1.

wiki.title: Wise (company)
wiki.text: Wise, formerly known as TransferWise, is a British financial technology company focused on global money transfers and Business Finance. Headquartered in London, it was founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus in January 2011. As of 2023, it offers three main products: Wise Account, Wise Business, and Wise Platform.

about: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank is a Sharia-compliant bank founded in 1997, serving retail, wealth, corporate and treasury clients in the UAE, with branches in Egypt, the UK and Qatar, and total assets above 150 billion dirhams. It is listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADIB). A strong consumer brand in the UAE and a sponsor of cultural and sporting events.

wiki.title: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank
wiki.text: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank PJSC is a major Islamic Emirati bank based in Abu Dhabi city. ADIB was ranked 12th on Forbes Middle East's 30 Most Valuable Banks 2025 list. It also ranked 27th on Forbes Middle East's Top 100 Listed Companies 2025 list. As of it manage 2,3 million current acounts.

about: U.S. Bancorp is a Minneapolis-based bank holding company, parent of U.S. Bank, with about 2,000 branches and over 65 billion dollars of revenue base scale (roughly 28 billion dollars revenue), 70,000 employees and assets near 670 billion dollars. It offers consumer banking, payments (Elavon) and wealth services. Listed on NYSE (USB). A major US consumer bank with naming rights deals, including U.S. Bank Stadium.

wiki.title: U.S. Bancorp
wiki.text: U.S. Bancorp is an American multinational banking institution headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and incorporated in Delaware. It is the 7th-largest bank in the United States as of March 2026. As the largest bank in the Midwestern United States, it is considered a domestic systemically important bank (D-SIB) by the Federal Reserve. It is the parent company of its primary operating entity, U.S. Bank National Association, which does business as U.S. Bank. The company provides banking, investment, mortgage, trust, and payment services products to individuals, businesses, governmental entities, and other financial institutions.

about: Fubon Financial Holdings is a Taipei financial group controlled by the Tsai family, with life insurance (Fubon Life), property insurance, Taipei Fubon Bank, securities and asset management, plus Hong Kong and China operations. It is one of Taiwan's largest groups, listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (2881). A strong consumer brand in Taiwan, owner of the Taipei Fubon Braves and Fubon Guardians sports teams.

Isbank (Turkiye Is Bankasi) is Turkey's largest private bank, headquartered in Istanbul and founded in 1924 at Ataturk's initiative, with around 1,200 branches and subsidiaries in insurance, asset management and the Sisecam industrial group. Listed on Borsa Istanbul (ISCTR). A major consumer brand across Turkey and a prominent sports sponsor. Customers are individuals and companies, and the bank has millions of clients. Its consumer brand is widely recognised in Turkey, and it supports sport and the arts.

wiki.title: İşbank
wiki.text: İşbank, officially Türkiye İş Bankası, is a commercial bank in Turkey. Founded by the orders of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk in 1924, it is the first bank to go into operation in the Republic of Türkiye.

about: Millennium bcp (Banco Comercial Portugues) is Portugal's largest privately owned bank, based in Lisbon and Porto, with retail and corporate banking in Portugal, Poland (Bank Millennium), Mozambique and Angola. Listed on Euronext Lisbon (BCP) with Fosun as a major shareholder. A strong consumer brand in Portugal and a notable sponsor of sport, including football and Portugal's Rock in Rio. Customers are households and companies, and revenue comes from interest and fees. Its consumer brand is well known across Portugal and Poland.

wiki.title: Banco Comercial Português
wiki.text: Banco Comercial Português is a Portuguese bank that was founded in 1985 and is the largest private bank in the country. BCP is a member of the Euronext 100 stock index and its current chief executive officer is Miguel Maya Dias Pinheiro. BCP is based in Porto, but its operations are headquartered in Oeiras, Greater Lisbon. It operates a branch brand-dubbed and restyled in 2004 as Millennium BCP as well as Banque BCP and ActivoBank.

about: Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) is a Jakarta-based Indonesian state-owned bank, listed on the IDX (BBNI), one of the four largest banks in the country with retail, SME and corporate customers and branches abroad. Founded in 1946. Strong consumer brand in Indonesia and a known sports sponsor there.

wiki.title: Bank Negara Indonesia
wiki.text: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is an Indonesian state-owned bank. It has branches primarily in Indonesia, but it can also be found in Seoul, Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Amsterdam, London and New York. It had 1,834 domestic branches, six overseas branches, two representative offices, one overseas sub-branch, and one remittance branch and more than 63 million customers in 2021. It is listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange as "BBNI".

about: Allstate is one of the largest US personal lines insurers, headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois. It sells auto, home, life and other insurance, mainly to consumers, via exclusive agents, direct channels and independent agents, and owns brands such as Esurance heritage products, Encompass, National General and Allstate Protection Plans. Revenue exceeds $55 billion and it serves tens of millions of policyholders, with around 55,000 employees. Founded in 1931 as part of Sears; listed on the NYSE (ALL). Very high US consumer brand awareness, a long-time major sports advertiser, and a strong candidate for F1 sponsorship.

wiki.title: Allstate
wiki.text: The Allstate Corporation is an American insurance company, headquartered in Glenview, Illinois since 2022. Founded in 1931 as part of Sears, Roebuck and Co., it was spun off in 1993, but was still partially owned by Sears until it became an independent company completely in June 1995. The company also has personal line insurance operations in Canada.

about: NCR Atleos is an Atlanta-based ATM and self-service banking company spun out of NCR in 2023. It makes and operates ATMs, runs a network of over 70,000 ATMs, including the Allpoint and Cardtronics-based networks, and provides software and managed services to banks, retailers and financial institutions in about 60 countries. Revenue is about 4 billion dollars. It is listed on the NYSE (NATL). B2B and consumer-facing ATM network brand, with modest public awareness.

wiki.title: NCR Atleos
wiki.text: NCR Atleos is an American ATM business service provider. This company specializes in ATM technology and related services, including ATM manufacturing, deployment, and maintenance. NCR Atleos is now the world's largest provider of ATMs and ATM services, according to some sources. The company is based in Atlanta, USA.

about: Temenos is a Geneva-based Swiss banking software company that supplies core banking, payments, digital banking, wealth management and fund administration software, such as Temenos Transact and Infinity, to banks in over 150 countries. Customers include retail banks, challenger banks and neo-banks, with revenue of about 1 billion dollars. Founded in 1993, it is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (TEMN). B2B software brand with no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Temenos
wiki.what: Piece of land assigned as an official domain or dedicated to gods
wiki.text: A temenos is a piece of land cut off and assigned as an official domain, especially to kings and chiefs, or a piece of land marked off from common uses and dedicated to a god, such as a sanctuary, holy grove, or holy precinct.

about: Finnish insurance group and the Nordic region's leading property and casualty insurer, with subsidiaries including If P&C (Nordics and Baltics), Topdanmark in Denmark and Hastings in the UK. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki; the life insurer Mandatum was spun off in 2023. Based in Helsinki. Customers are individuals and businesses buying motor, home, accident and commercial policies. Funding of about EUR 300 million shown for September 2025, likely bonds. Strong consumer insurance brands in the Nordics, particularly If.

wiki.title: Sampo Group
wiki.text: Sampo Group is a property and casualty (P&C) insurance group with operations in the Nordics, Baltics, and the UK. Sampo operates in four segments: Private in the Nordics and the UK, and Commercial and Industrial in the Nordics.

about: Austrian banking group based in Vienna and listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange, serving customers in Central and Eastern Europe through Raiffeisen Bank subsidiaries in markets such as Poland, Czech Republic, Croatia and Romania, and in Austria. Assets are in the hundreds of billions of euros. Its Russian subsidiary has drawn scrutiny since 2022. Funding of about $239 million shown. The Raiffeisen name is a strong consumer banking brand across the region, with regular sport and culture sponsorship.

wiki.title: Raiffeisen Bank International
wiki.text: Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) is a key entity of the decentralized Raiffeisen Banking Group in Austria, acting both as the latter's domestic central financial entity and as the holding company for all the group's operations outside of Austria. The bank is listed on the Wiener Börse. Its major shareholders are the Raiffeisen Banking Group's eight regional banks (Raiffeisen-Landesbanken), which are bound by a shareholders' agreement and together hold a majority of RBI's equity.

about: Swiss private bank and asset manager based in Zurich and listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (VONN), controlled by the Vontobel family foundation. Offers wealth management, investment banking, structured products and multi-boutique asset management for private and institutional clients worldwide. Manages well over CHF 200 billion in client assets. Funding of about CHF 200 million shown. Known in Swiss finance and a sponsor of sporting and cultural events in Switzerland, with limited awareness abroad.

wiki.title: Vontobel
wiki.text: Bank Vontobel is an international private bank and investment management firm with Swiss roots, providing private banking and investment services such as investment funds, structured products and segregated mandates to private and institutional clients. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, the firm was founded as Haeberli & Cie in 1924 and is now present across 27 locations world-wide.
